n2f05dc6ed7.headline: Fragile countries make $20 billion climate finance push at COP29, letter says
n2f05dc6ed7.summary: Countries affected by conflict say they struggle to attract private investment because they are seen as too risky. Their letter at COP29 calls for a $20 billion climate finance push.
n2f05dc6ed7.why: Climate finance flows determine how much private capital goes into adaptation and clean energy projects in developing economies.

n5a083b7a5e.headline: RenaissanceRe seeks $250m Mona Lisa Re 2025-1 cat bond for itself and DaVinci - Artemis.bm
n5a083b7a5e.summary: Bermuda-based reinsurer RenaissanceRe is seeking $250 million through the Mona Lisa Re 2025-1 catastrophe bond for itself and DaVinci. The deal returns the company to the cat bond market.
n5a083b7a5e.why: Catastrophe bonds transfer insurance risk to capital-market investors and are a growing source of reinsurance capacity.

source.name: Artemis.bm - The Catastrophe Bond, Insurance Linked Securities & Investment, Rei

sources.name: Artemis.bm - The Catastrophe Bond, Insurance Linked Securities & Investment, Rei

nd0475086ce.headline: Jamie Dimon says bankers are 'dancing in the street' because they expect Trump to cut regulation
nd0475086ce.summary: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon said Wall Street was buzzing at the prospect of Trump deregulating banking. He said this would make it easier to do business.
nd0475086ce.why: JPMorgan Chase is the largest US bank by assets. Its chief executive's views on regulation signal how major lenders expect rules to change.

n943678101e.headline: UBA Seeks To Raise N239.4 Billion Through A Rights Issuance
n943678101e.summary: UBA is seeking to raise N239.4 billion through a rights issuance. The report is from The News Chronicle and gives no further detail in the input.
n943678101e.why: United Bank for Africa is a Nigerian lender with pan-African operations. Rights issues raise fresh capital and can dilute existing shareholders.

n3d1fbc81c4.headline: Greatland Gold to complete Havieron/Telfer acquisition 'early next month'
n3d1fbc81c4.summary: Greatland Gold said it expects to complete the acquisition of the Havieron project and Telfer mine by early next month. The company is listed on AIM and OTC markets.
n3d1fbc81c4.why: Greatland Gold is a gold and copper explorer and developer with projects in Western Australia. Acquisitions of producing or development-stage mines change a junior miner's asset base and funding profile.

n0cb839bdbf.headline: Croatia to purchase famed Turkish combat drones in $91M deal
n0cb839bdbf.summary: Croatia announced an 86 million euro ($91 million) deal to purchase lethal drones from Türkiye. The announcement came days after a parliamentary vote, according to the input.
n0cb839bdbf.why: Defence procurement contracts between governments shape defence industry revenues and bilateral trade ties. Türkiye is a growing exporter of military hardware.

n25ab7a4fdf.headline: United States and the Government of Liberia Sign $114.4 Million Agreement to Advance Liberia’s Development Goals
n25ab7a4fdf.summary: The United States, through USAID, and the Government of Liberia signed a $114.4 million agreement to advance Liberia's development goals. The signing was dated November 13, 2024.
n25ab7a4fdf.why: Official development assistance agreements fund public programmes in recipient countries and shape their budgets and project pipelines.

n7bf4e59dbb.headline: SPE Capital injects 450 million MAD into Dislog Group
n7bf4e59dbb.summary: SPE Capital Partners, a private equity firm, has finalised a strategic investment of MAD 450 million in Dislog Group. The stake is a private equity investment in a Moroccan group.
n7bf4e59dbb.why: Private equity firms buy stakes in private and listed companies to fund growth and restructuring, which affects valuations and capital flows in local markets.

n37511be763.headline: Australian PM Takes Green Pitch to World Ahead of Trump’s Return
n37511be763.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is seeking global investment in the nation's green energy and technology sectors. The pitch comes ahead of Donald Trump's return to the White House.
n37511be763.why: Australia is a major exporter of minerals and energy, and government investment pitches influence capital flows into its renewable and technology sectors.

n3bcce58c34.headline: Construction output up but ONS figures still a ‘mixed bag’
n3bcce58c34.summary: UK construction output is estimated to have increased by 0.8% in Q3 2024 compared with Q2 2024. The Office for National Statistics figures were described as a mixed bag.
n3bcce58c34.why: Construction output is a key indicator of economic activity, and the ONS quarterly figures feed into Bank of England and government economic assessments.

n18a3cf4451.headline: Spanish utility Cox shares fall in market debut
n18a3cf4451.summary: Shares in Spanish clean energy and water utility Cox fell more than 3% in their trading debut on Friday. Some investors voiced worries about renewable energy after Donald Trump's election.
n18a3cf4451.why: Cox is a Spanish clean energy and water utility, and its share performance reflects investor sentiment toward renewable energy. Its debut is a test of demand for listed utilities.

nb0d23baf42.headline: FG Promissory Notes Jump To N1.65 Trillion, Up 114% In A Year Under Tinubu
nb0d23baf42.summary: Federal government promissory notes in Nigeria have risen to N1.65 trillion, up 114% in a year under President Tinubu, according to the report.
nb0d23baf42.why: Promissory notes are government debt instruments used to settle obligations such as arrears. Rising balances affect Nigeria's fiscal position and the liquidity of its financial system.

nd710b271c4.headline: Microsoft in the FTC's cross-hairs after cloud computing probe
nd710b271c4.summary: The Federal Trade Commission is preparing to investigate Microsoft for potential anti-competitive practices in its cloud computing business, following a probe.
nd710b271c4.why: Microsoft is one of the largest cloud computing providers, and antitrust scrutiny can affect its licensing and cloud strategy. Regulatory action in this area can reshape competition in the sector.

impacts.name: Microsoft
impacts.why: The FTC is preparing an investigation into the company's cloud computing practices.

n0be72c4d2b.headline: COP29: Pacific climate finance needs top $2billion
n0be72c4d2b.summary: Economic modelling released at the COP29 climate conference in Baku showed Pacific nations need at least US$1.5 billion per year in climate finance.
n0be72c4d2b.why: Climate finance flows from developed to developing economies and shapes investment in adaptation and infrastructure in vulnerable island states.

n7071c8d94d.headline: Xi Jinping opens huge port in Peru funded by China
n7071c8d94d.summary: Xi Jinping opened the Chancay port in Peru, a $1.3 billion Chinese-funded project. Washington has raised concerns that it could be used by the Chinese navy and for intelligence-gathering.
n7071c8d94d.why: Chancay is a deep-water port that links Pacific trade routes with South America, and Chinese ownership makes it a focus of US-China competition over trade infrastructure.

nee5dc5fd96.headline: FG Intends To Raise N120 Billion In The Bond Auction In November
nee5dc5fd96.summary: The Federal Government of Nigeria intends to raise N120 billion through a bond auction in November. The sale is a domestic borrowing operation.
nee5dc5fd96.why: Government bond auctions set borrowing costs and absorb liquidity from local banks and investors. Yields on naira bonds are a benchmark for Nigerian interest rates.

nfc11961031.headline: Ben and Jerry
nfc11961031.summary: Ben & Jerry's is suing its parent company for allegedly silencing the ice cream brand as it sought to back Palestinian refugees and call for a Gaza ceasefire. The brand is an ice cream maker based in Vermont.
nfc11961031.why: Ben & Jerry's is an ice cream brand owned by a larger multinational consumer goods group, and disputes over brand control can affect its reputation and governance.

na1b0470c61.headline: Projection looks GOOD for petrol price CUT in December 2024
na1b0470c61.summary: The latest data suggests South African motorists will enjoy a petrol price cut in early December 2024. The projection is based on the latest available data.
na1b0470c61.why: Petrol pump prices in South Africa are set monthly from fuel price data and feed into household costs and inflation.

n891dcda70d.headline: South African Reserve Bank to cut rates 25bps to 7.75% on Nov. 21 - Reuters poll
n891dcda70d.summary: A Reuters poll expects the South African Reserve Bank to cut its repo rate by 25 basis points to 7.75% on November 21, as inflation slows.
n891dcda70d.why: The South African Reserve Bank sets the repo rate, which anchors borrowing costs and the rand's yield appeal in South Africa.

n74f1e42804.headline: Apec leaders to open Lima summit as Trump prepares to return to office
n74f1e42804.summary: APEC leaders are gathering in Lima for their annual summit. The members jointly account for almost two-thirds of global GDP, as Trump prepares to return to office.
n74f1e42804.why: APEC is the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum, whose members include major trading economies, so its agenda affects regional trade and investment.

n8bca70a7ef.headline: Govt Expects Electric Vehicle Adoption in Pakistan to Reach 90% in Just 16 Years
n8bca70a7ef.summary: Government expects electric vehicle adoption in Pakistan to reach 30 percent by 2030, 90 percent by 2040 and 100 percent by 2050. The policy also sets out the transition path.
n8bca70a7ef.why: Electric vehicle adoption targets influence demand for vehicles, charging infrastructure and battery supply chains. Pakistan's auto market is a sizeable emerging market.

n56921b665d.headline: FEC Approves N47.9 Trillion Budget For 2025
n56921b665d.summary: Nigeria's Federal Executive Council approved a N47.9 trillion budget for 2025. The approval is the government's spending plan for the year.
n56921b665d.why: The federal budget sets government spending and borrowing needs in Africa's largest economy by GDP. It shapes naira liquidity, sovereign debt issuance and fiscal policy.

nb1b7fe232a.headline: End of Tax Credit Could Be End of Lucid
nb1b7fe232a.summary: The end of the $7,500 federal tax credit for buying an electric vehicle could be the end of EV maker Lucid, the article argues. It says Lucid has little else going for it.
nb1b7fe232a.why: Lucid Group is a US electric vehicle maker. Federal EV incentives affect consumer demand for its vehicles.

nf1d1d1775a.headline: Short term rental of real estate: Window to extend the suspension of the issue of new licences – Which areas it concerns
nf1d1d1775a.summary: A ban on issuing new permits for short-term rental apartments in Athens may begin to apply in 45 days. The measure could be extended to other areas, according to the report.
nf1d1d1775a.why: Short-term rental restrictions affect property values, rental yields and tourism-related real estate investment in Greek cities.

n578264a045.headline: EMEA Morning Briefing :  Investors Parse Powell's Caution
n578264a045.summary: European stock futures were lower after Asian stocks broadly fell, while the dollar held steady. Investors were weighing Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell's caution, with UK GDP data also due.
n578264a045.why: The S&P 500 tracks the largest US listed companies, and Federal Reserve signals on interest rates shape global equity valuations.

n727de1141d.headline: Mexico Unveils 2025 Budget Draft That Narrows Fiscal Deficit
n727de1141d.summary: Mexico's government said it will narrow the fiscal deficit next year, even as President Claudia Sheinbaum pledges to boost social programs and support the heavily indebted state oil company.
n727de1141d.why: Mexico's budget and deficit path affect sovereign credit ratings, peso sentiment and the outlook for public borrowing in Latin America's second-largest economy.

n41a121a5b5.headline: Electrical current: Horizontal subsidies come to the accounts as long as the rise rally continues
n41a121a5b5.summary: Greece's government is reconsidering horizontal subsidies for electricity as prices keep rising. Relevant ministries are monitoring the issue closely.
n41a121a5b5.why: Electricity subsidies affect public finances and household and business energy costs in Greece.

nf69c1499e9.headline: TIM, return to dividend and focus on extraordinary gains
nf69c1499e9.summary: Telecom Italia shares rose sharply after first nine-month results and the prospect of resuming the dividend suspended since 2020. The reported gains were cited as a driver.
nf69c1499e9.why: Telecom Italia is Italy's major telecom operator, and dividend decisions matter to income-focused investors in Italian equities.

impacts.why: Shares rose sharply after results and dividend prospects, per the input.

n797a4a4093.why: Lamda Development is a major Greek real estate developer, and its land sales indicate demand for Athens property projects.

n58eb60809c.headline: EU hits Facebook owner Meta with €798m Marketplace fine
n58eb60809c.summary: The European Union has fined Facebook owner Meta Platforms €798 million for forcing advertisers onto its Marketplace service. The penalty is a notable regulatory action against a major US tech platform.
n58eb60809c.why: Meta Platforms owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, and its advertising business generates most of its revenue. EU fines can affect its European operations and future compliance costs.

nc0075e445f.summary: The Ogun State government said a task force set up in the petroleum industry aims to address fuel meter tampering and other sharp practices. The measure targets fuel retail irregularities in the state.
nc0075e445f.why: Fuel retail is a large part of Nigeria's downstream oil market, and pricing and dispensing integrity affect consumers and marketers. State-level enforcement affects local fuel distribution.

nbce02979cc.summary: Alibaba Group missed analysts' estimates for quarterly sales on Friday. Economic uncertainty in China weighed on consumer spending and on the e-commerce giant's domestic business.
nbce02979cc.why: Alibaba is one of China's largest e-commerce and cloud companies, and its results are a closely watched gauge of Chinese consumer demand and of the wider Chinese internet sector.

n3ca990ba49.headline: Swiss solar panel maker Meyer Burger's future in doubt after key client quits
n3ca990ba49.summary: Meyer Burger said its future looked uncertain after its biggest customer ended its agreement with the struggling solar panel maker. The company is trying to address its position.
n3ca990ba49.why: Meyer Burger is a Swiss manufacturer of solar panel production equipment and modules, and the loss of a key client raises questions about its viability.

ne5af7a2b56.headline: FG Promissory Notes rise to N1.65 trillion, up 114% in one year under Tinubu
ne5af7a2b56.summary: Nigeria's Debt Management Office reports federal government Promissory Notes debt rose to N1.65 trillion as of June 2024, a 6.5% increase from March 2024. The debt is up 114% in one year.
ne5af7a2b56.why: Promissory Notes are government IOUs used to settle obligations, so their growth adds to Nigeria's public debt burden, which matters for sovereign credit risk and the naira.

n08b3da175d.headline: How Low Oil Prices Saved America From Inflation
n08b3da175d.summary: The October consumer price index shows that low oil and gasoline prices, linked to geopolitical pressures, have helped keep US inflation contained.
n08b3da175d.why: The consumer price index measures the cost of everyday goods and services and guides Federal Reserve interest-rate decisions. Energy prices are a major driver of headline inflation.

n0bf7695f28.headline: Lebanon lost $5bn in year of war with Israel, World Bank says
n0bf7695f28.summary: The World Bank said a year of conflict between Hezbollah and Israel caused more than $5 billion in economic losses in Lebanon and damaged close to 100,000 homes.
n0bf7695f28.why: The World Bank is the multilateral lender that assesses economic damage and reconstruction needs in conflict-affected countries.

n87c2beb546.headline: SPOA: UK Budget signals death of Scottish plant hire industry
n87c2beb546.summary: The Scottish Plant Owners Association says the Autumn Budget measures signal the decline of Scotland's plant hire industry, noting 85% of its 350 members are private independent operators.
n87c2beb546.why: Plant hire firms rent construction machinery and their costs and demand are tied to UK budget policy and construction activity.

nb1584fe0d5.headline: SNDL :  Announces Renewal of Share Repurchase Program Form 6 K
nb1584fe0d5.summary: SNDL Inc. announced that its board of directors has approved the renewal of its share repurchase program.
nb1584fe0d5.why: SNDL is a Calgary-based cannabis and retail company, and buybacks return capital to shareholders by reducing shares outstanding.

n764d523c22.headline: Why did the UK economy slow in the third quarter, and what does it mean?
n764d523c22.summary: Newly published GDP figures showed the UK economy slowed in the third quarter. PA examines what the data mean for the wider economy, households and the Government.
n764d523c22.why: GDP growth is the headline measure of UK economic output and shapes Bank of England policy expectations and government fiscal decisions.

n8a202d6c33.headline: State Budget 2025: Sabah plans to impose sales tax on gold to boost revenue next year
n8a202d6c33.summary: Sabah plans to extend its state sales tax to gold under its Budget 2025, tabled by Finance Minister Masidi Manjun in Kota Kinabalu. The measure aims to boost state revenue next year.
n8a202d6c33.why: Sabah is a Malaysian state with its own budget and tax powers, and changes to taxes on gold affect local jewellery and bullion trade.

ndc1c698624.headline: Sterling heads for worst weekly performance since January
ndc1c698624.summary: The pound was on track for its biggest weekly loss since January, pressured by weak UK economic data and a surging dollar. Investors' conviction on the dollar was cited as a factor.
ndc1c698624.why: Sterling's exchange rate affects the earnings of UK companies with overseas revenue and the cost of imports, and it shapes Bank of England policy expectations.
ndc1c698624.why_moved: The article cites weak UK economic data and a surging dollar, which is getting support from investors' conviction in the currency.

n278ece2b46.headline: Bank Alfalah Imposes 5% Monthly Fee on High Value Accounts
n278ece2b46.summary: Bank Alfalah has imposed a 5 percent monthly fee on all checking accounts with month-end balances of Rs. 5 billion and above, or equivalent.
n278ece2b46.why: Bank Alfalah is a Pakistani commercial bank, and fee changes on large accounts affect corporate treasury costs and deposit competition.

n01524ae2b5.headline: Why Edward Jones says a newly reached advisor milestone is key to growth
n01524ae2b5.summary: Edward Jones has achieved a major advisor headcount milestone, which the firm sees as key to its growth.
n01524ae2b5.why: Edward Jones is a large US retail brokerage and wealth manager, and its advisor headcount is a key driver of its client reach.

n2ef737483d.headline: Spectrum Brands :  Reports Fiscal 2024 Fourth Quarter Form 8 K
n2ef737483d.summary: Spectrum Brands reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2024 net sales up 4.5%, with organic net sales up 4.8%. Net income for the quarter was $12.8 million.
n2ef737483d.why: Spectrum Brands is a US consumer products company whose portfolio includes home, pet and personal care brands. Its quarterly results give investors a read on consumer demand for its products.

n3a52c7791f.headline: Cabasse:  target return to profitable Ebitda
n3a52c7791f.summary: A week after its capital increase was shunned by the market, Cabasse suggested a possible return to operating profit in 2025 from cost cuts. The company sought to reassure investors on Friday.
n3a52c7791f.why: Cabasse is a French audio equipment maker. A failed share issue and a profit-recovery plan are key signals for investors about its funding and financial health.

nbc19839e90.headline: Japan's economy grows for a second straight quarter on the back of consumer spending
nbc19839e90.summary: Japan's economy eked out annualised growth of 0.9% in the July-September quarter, as consumer spending held up, extending growth for a second straight quarter.
nbc19839e90.why: Japan is the world's fourth-largest economy, and its GDP trends influence Bank of Japan policy and the yen as well as the Nikkei index.

n1060d70aea.headline: Stock market today: Wall Street tumbles as the “Trump bump” fades and vaccine makers sink
n1060d70aea.summary: US stocks posted their worst loss since Election Day as gains from Donald Trump's victory and a Federal Reserve rate cut kept fading. Vaccine makers also sank.
n1060d70aea.why: US equities such as the S&P 500 are the main global benchmark for risk appetite, and their moves shape investor sentiment worldwide.
n1060d70aea.why_moved: The boost from Donald Trump's election victory and a Federal Reserve rate cut kept fading, leading to a broad sell-off.

n030c79a9a3.headline: CREATE MORE to support business expansion – PCCI
n030c79a9a3.summary: The Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry expects approval of the CREATE MORE Act to help businesses expand. It says the law would position the Philippines as a globally competitive investment destination.
n030c79a9a3.why: The PCCI is the country's largest business organization, and its views reflect the stance of much of the Philippine corporate sector on policy.

n54e404c1f5.headline: Give us a chance to sort out housing and deliver 9% VAT rate, McDonald says
n54e404c1f5.summary: Sinn Fein leader Mary Lou McDonald said an appetite for change in Ireland 'is very real and very live'. She urged voters to give the party a chance to deal with housing and deliver a 9% VAT rate.
n54e404c1f5.why: VAT, or value-added tax, is a consumption tax, and its rate affects prices and government revenue.

nd4b52ce46f.headline: Uy-led Chelsea close to recovery, but Dito sinks deeper into red
nd4b52ce46f.summary: Dennis Uy's logistics venture is close to erasing its net loss on shipping recovery. His telecom company Dito is struggling with a heavy debt burden.
nd4b52ce46f.why: Chelsea Logistics and Dito are private Philippine conglomerate ventures, and Dito's debt load matters for lenders in the telecom sector.

n6cea02842e.headline: Megawide profit surges by 69 percent in 9 months
n6cea02842e.summary: Megawide Construction Corp. nine-month earnings rose more than 50 percent, reported as 69 percent, to the end of September. Higher revenues and lower costs drove the gain.
n6cea02842e.why: Megawide is a Philippine construction firm involved in infrastructure projects, so its results reflect public and private construction activity.

n261228ec83.headline: Petrol Prices in Pakistan from November 16
n261228ec83.summary: The Pakistani government decided to maintain rates of petrol, diesel and other petroleum products for the second half of November 2024. A notification was issued to that effect.
n261228ec83.why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport costs and inflation, and are closely watched by businesses and households.

nfa5adba8dd.headline: PetroEnergy profit down 20 percent to P692 million
nfa5adba8dd.summary: PetroEnergy Resources' earnings fell by double digits from January to September. The company cited higher costs from an aggressive portfolio buildup.
nfa5adba8dd.why: PetroEnergy Resources is a Philippine oil and gas company, and its earnings reflect exploration and portfolio spending.

n5696fcd788.headline: AGI nets P13 billion from January to September
n5696fcd788.summary: Alliance Global Group posted flat earnings for January to September, while revenues expanded. The company cited resilient performance across its business segments.
n5696fcd788.why: Alliance Global is a diversified Philippine conglomerate with property, food and gaming units, so its results reflect broad domestic consumer and property demand.

nc45131edfe.headline: SM Prime to consolidate all residential projects
nc45131edfe.summary: SM Prime Holdings will consolidate all residential projects under the SM Residences brand. The move is part of a reformat and expansion to optimise revenue mix across business units.
nc45131edfe.why: SM Prime is a major Philippine property developer, and portfolio reorganisation affects its residential revenue and branding strategy.

nc34c2511a3.headline: Canadian Tire selling industrial property in Brampton, Ont., for $258M
nc34c2511a3.summary: Canadian Tire Corp. has signed a deal to sell an industrial property in the Greater Toronto Area for $258 million. The buyer is not named in the description.
nc34c2511a3.why: Canadian Tire is a large Canadian retailer, and property sales can raise cash and affect its real estate holdings.

nd6b723be77.headline: Utility sector leads Australian shares higher
nd6b723be77.summary: The local share market finished Friday up 0.7%, with the utility sector leading gains, but it did not recover all of its earlier losses.
nd6b723be77.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark equity index, and utilities are a defensive sector that is sensitive to interest rates.

n7bcdc97dc9.summary: Ferrovial and joint venture partner Macquarie have agreed to sell AGS Airports, which owns Aberdeen, Glasgow and Southampton airports, to AviAlliance for £900m, within a £1.53bn deal.
n7bcdc97dc9.why: Ferrovial is a Spanish infrastructure group and Macquarie is an Australian investment bank and asset manager, both active owners of airports and transport assets.

n75249b1fbc.summary: Public opinion is divided on Donald Trump's proposal to create a Department of Government Efficiency, which could impact government operations and fiscal management.
n75249b1fbc.why: Proposals to reform government efficiency can influence policy priorities and budget allocations.

nb1239890f5.headline: China’s Xi, Peru’s Boluarte Open $1.3 Billion Port Near Lima
nb1239890f5.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping and Peruvian President Dina Boluarte opened a $1.3 billion port, potentially transforming South American trade with Asia.

n56ea8e13a0.headline: China's EV sector reaches 10 million production milestone, overcapacity fears deepen
n56ea8e13a0.summary: China's electric vehicle production surpassed 10 million units annually, raising concerns about overcapacity in the sector.
n56ea8e13a0.why: China's EV industry is a major global supplier, and overcapacity could impact prices, margins, and investment in the sector.

n38d398c040.headline: Amid More Uncertainty, Global Leaders Focus on UN Climate Conference Targets
n38d398c040.summary: COP29 in Azerbaijan sees nations addressing climate change mitigation despite political and financial hurdles.
n38d398c040.why: Climate negotiations influence global policies and investments in renewable energy and emissions reduction.

n2c858af45e.headline: Fujitsu Ltd: Fujitsu collaborates with global suppliers in decarbonization initiative to exchange product-level primary data on CO2 emissions
n2c858af45e.summary: Fujitsu has initiated a decarbonization project with global suppliers to exchange product-level CO2 emissions data.
n2c858af45e.why: This initiative aims to improve supply chain transparency and reduce carbon footprints, relevant for companies and investors focusing on ESG and sustainability.

nc89675b50a.headline: Cheaper to get prescribed meds from private clinics and pharmacies, says MPS
nc89675b50a.summary: Malaysian pharmacists recommend purchasing prescribed medicines from community pharmacies to reduce healthcare costs.
nc89675b50a.why: Healthcare costs and pharmaceutical sector trends impact consumer spending and sector valuations in Malaysia.

nf08c28eabd.headline: Maghreb: After the IMF, the World Bank Announces Good News for One Country
nf08c28eabd.summary: The World Bank's regional director said Algeria's economic outlook is favorable. Growth rose from 3% in 2021 to 4.1% in 2023, with optimistic forecasts for 2024.
nf08c28eabd.why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender whose growth assessments inform investor views of developing economies and their sovereign credit risk.

n0a39c0059c.headline: Government Announces Elimination of Taxes on Online Purchases Abroad and Raises Shipment Limit to U$S 3,000
n0a39c0059c.summary: The government will raise the import limit per shipment from $1,000 to $3,000. No duties will be charged on the first $400 per shipment.
n0a39c0059c.why: Changes to import duties and cross-border e-commerce rules affect retailers, logistics firms and consumer spending in Argentina.
